caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden pitcher positioned upright, with a handle on the right side. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown, highlighting the texture and grain of the wood. A dark metal band is wrapped around the bottom of the pitcher, and a thin, dark wire bracing curves from the top left to lower right, attached at two points to the body. The pitcher has a wide, oval opening with thick walls, and the top edge undulates slightly. The shadow of the pitcher extends to the bottom right on a light background. The entire subject is centered within a rectangular frame drawn with a thin line. The composition is simple, with no other objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Pitcher
